sentences.cn_source: 有丰富的廉价劳动力供应。

sentences.c: I have ever had abundant love experiences.
sentences.cn_source: 我曾经有过丰富的感情经历。

sentences.c: Our country has a vast territory and abundant resources.
sentences.cn_source: 我国土地辽阔， 资源丰富。

trans.cn: Người Inca; người Inca
trans.cn_source: 印加；印加人

sentences.c: Driving the steep road to the mountaintop Inca ruins of Machu Picchu is potentially dangerous and hiking there is difficult.
sentences.cn_source: 沿着陡峭的道路驱车前往马丘比丘的印加遗址山顶是很危险的，在那里徒步旅行也很困难。

sentences.c: Thor Heyerdahl, the Norwegian ethnographer and adventurer, thought the statues had been created by pre-Inca peoples from Peru.
sentences.cn_source: 挪威民族志学者、冒险家托尔·海尔达尔认为，这些雕像是由来自秘鲁的前印加人创造的。

sentences.c: However, not all functional objects are exactly alike; that is why we recognize a Shang Dynasty vase as being different from an Inca vase.
sentences.cn_source: 然而，并不是所有的功能物品都完全相同；这就是我们认为商代花瓶不同于印加花瓶的原因。

trans.cn: Cai trị, quản lý; kiểm soát, ảnh hưởng; (ngữ pháp) chiếm ưu thế; có thể được sử dụng để cai trị (một trường hợp nhất định)

trans.cn_source: 【名】 （Govern）（英）戈文（人名）

sentences.c: They were utterly unfit to govern.
sentences.cn_source: 他们完全不胜任管理。

sentences.c: He was inept and lacked the intelligence to govern.
sentences.cn_source: 他无能而且缺乏管理才干。

sentences.c: He accused the opposition party of being unfit to govern.
sentences.cn_source: 他指责反对党不适合治理国事。

sentences.cn_source: 游泳池从早上7点起开放。

sentences.c: They lived there from the 1980s onwards.
sentences.cn_source: 他们从1980年代起一直住在那里。

sentences.c: The little tailor went onwards, always following his own pointed nose.
sentences.cn_source: 小裁缝继续赶他的路，一直向前走去。

trans.cn: như một điểm đến
trans.cn_source: 作为目的地的

sentences.c: Our luggage was checked all the way through to our final destination.
sentences.cn_source: 我们的行李一直被托运到最终目的地。

sentences.c: At last, after twenty hours on the boat, they arrived at their destination.
sentences.cn_source: 乘船二十小时之后，他们终于到达了目的地。

sentences.c: He gets you to your destination without turning the trip into a white-knuckle experience.
sentences.cn_source: 他会将你安然无恙地送达你的目的地。

trans.cn: Machu Picchu (Peru)
trans.cn_source: 马丘比丘（秘鲁）

trans.cn: Machu Picchu (thành phố cổ, nằm ở trung nam Peru)
trans.cn_source: 马丘比丘（古城，位于秘鲁中部偏南）

sentences.c: There are many museums, where you can learn how the ancient American Indians founded the Inca Empire and built Machu Picchu, a famous ancient city in the Andes Mountains.
sentences.cn_source: 那里有很多博物馆，在那里你可以了解到古老的美洲印第安人是如何创建印加帝国和马丘比丘的，马丘比丘是安第斯山脉中一座著名的古城。

sentences.c: Driving the steep road to the mountaintop Inca ruins of Machu Picchu is potentially dangerous and hiking there is difficult.
sentences.cn_source: 沿着陡峭的道路驱车前往马丘比丘的印加遗址山顶是很危险的，在那里徒步旅行也很困难。

sentences.c: Some of the world's finest stone architecture can be seen in the ruins of the ancient Inca city of Machu Picchu high in the eastern Andes Mountains of Peru.
sentences.cn_source: 在秘鲁安第斯山脉东部的马丘比丘古城遗址中，可以看到世界上一些最精美的石头建筑。

trans.cn: Một quán trọ hoặc quán rượu nhỏ (đặc biệt ở khu vực nông thôn); (dùng trong tên quán trọ) khách sạn hoặc nhà hàng
trans.cn_source: （尤指乡村的）小旅馆，小酒馆；（用于旅馆的名字中）酒店，饭店

sentences.c: I always feel at home at Ye Olde Starre Inn.
sentences.cn_source: 在昨日星辰客栈，我总是觉得非常舒适安逸。

sentences.c: I learnt that the house had formerly been an inn.
sentences.cn_source: 我得知这座房子以前是家客栈。

sentences.c: She washed her face at the pump in front of the inn.
sentences.cn_source: 她在客栈前的水泵旁洗了洗脸。

phrases.cn_source: n. 假日酒店；假日旅馆

sentences.cn_source: 延迟午夜的最后期限是根本不可能的。

sentences.cn_source: 啊，不，这是不可能的。

sentences.cn_source: 一份好工作是不可能的。

sentences.c: The site is reached by a 30-minute hike through dense forest.
sentences.cn_source: 要花30分钟徒步穿过密林才能到达那个地方。

sentences.c: He had been bitten by a snake during a rough hike.
sentences.cn_source: 他在一次艰难的徒步旅行中被蛇咬了。

sentences.c: Join a small group hike tour for an evening of exploration in the heart of Washington.
sentences.cn_source: 加入小型徒步旅行团，用一个晚上去探索华盛顿的中心。

sentences.c: Puno said arrests would soon take place.
sentences.cn_source: 普诺说，逮捕行动将很快进行。

sentences.c: In Peru la Diablada, or the Devil's Dance, is played at the carnival of Puno in the south of the country.
sentences.cn_source: 在秘鲁，这种名为“恶魔之舞”的舞蹈是在南部的普诺嘉年华中表演。

sentences.c: The interior secretary, Ronaldo Puno, said he had warned the family they risked a military attack unless they handed over Ampatuan by midday.
sentences.cn_source: 内政部长罗纳尔多·普诺(Ronaldo Puno)说，他曾警告安帕图恩家族，除非他们在中午前交出安帕图恩，否则可能遭到武装袭击。

sentences.cn_source: 但我始终没有找到她的陵墓。

sentences.c: This place is like a tomb.

sentences.c: The Amazon River is 3,980 miles long.
sentences.cn_source: 亚马逊河长3980英里。

sentences.c: The Amazon River begins in the Andes Mountains in Peru.
sentences.cn_source: 亚马逊河发源于秘鲁的安第斯山脉。

sentences.c: You really ought to take a boat down the Amazon.
sentences.cn_source: 你真的应该乘船去亚马逊河。

sentences.c: Venetian merchants traded extensively in silk and encouraged silk growers to settle in Italy.
sentences.cn_source: 威尼斯商人大量买卖丝绸，并鼓励丝绸种植者在意大利定居。

sentences.c: A group of English scholars left the French capital in 1167 to settle in Oxford and the place became a magnet for students and teachers from all over Britain.
sentences.cn_source: 1167年，一群英国学者离开法国首都，定居在牛津，而后牛津吸引了全英国教师和学生。

sentences.c: He took a long time to settle in to big-time football.
sentences.cn_source: 他花了很长时间才在第一流的足球运动中立足。
